laws.rule: Nkasa Rupara National Park: MEFT states a 4x4 with recovery equipment is required and visitors must be self-sufficient because facilities are absent. It names designated camping areas Mparamura/Nzalu and Lyadura. Fees can be paid beforehand at MEFT offices or on arrival; no amount or assurance of a campsite booking is inferred.

Mudumu National Park: MEFT states visitors must provide their own water, food and fuel. Park signs indicate 4x4 vehicles. At least two 4x4 vehicles are RECOMMENDED during the rainy season, not stated as a universal statutory convoy requirement. An unfenced park and absence of a formal entrance gate do not establish permission to ignore access requirements.
